info.title: Cellar API
info.description:
The HTTP API of Cellar, a self-hosted wine cellar manager. [docs/API.md](https://github.com/Lulu300/cellar/blob/main/docs/API.md) describes each route in full, with the fields of its answers, which this description leaves out; the request bodies here come from the schemas that the server checks them with. `GET /api/openapi.json` serves this description, for the version that runs.

- **Lengths:** a name, a producer, a description, a note, a grape variety or a case suffix is measured in UTF-16 units once trimmed (a case suffix at its end only), as JavaScript's `.length`, a note or a description with its line breaks as LF. `maxLength` gives that limit, but a JSON Schema validator counts characters, an emoji as one: it may accept a text with emoji that the server refuses.
- **Reads are public:** every `GET` outside `/api/admin` works without a session. Every other method, and all of `/api/admin`, needs one; `POST /api/access-code` logs in and sets the `cellar_session` cookie.
- **MCP token:** the token of Admin › Settings › MCP access opens the MCP server at `/mcp`, outside this API, and nothing here: sent to a route of this API, it counts for nothing.
- **Origin check:** a write whose `Origin` header is not Cellar's URL gets `403 cross_site_request`, and a form upload (`multipart/form-data`) or a write without `Content-Type` must send that header. Send `Origin` with every write.
- **Errors:** every error answer has the body of the `Error` response, except the `403` of a form write without `Origin`, which comes from the server before Cellar's code runs.

cronToken.description: The token of the cron job, generated in Admin › Backups.

Error.description: An error, with its status and a stable `code`. Any route may answer `400 malformed_body`, `401 unauthenticated`, `403 cross_site_request`, `404 not_found`, `405 method_not_allowed`, `409 missing_reference` or `in_use`, `413 body_too_large`, `422 invalid_body` (`details` lists each problem as `{ path, message }`), `500 internal_error` and, for a write while a restore, an import or a wipe runs, `503 writes_held` with a `Retry-After` header. The other codes belong to some routes, which docs/API.md lists.

message.description: In English, for logs and people; it may change.

details.description: Only for some codes, which docs/API.md lists.
